name: smith hex press
description: A press with the weights squeezed together, done on a Smith machine. The squeeze keeps tension on the chest throughout.
instructions: Lie on a bench under the Smith bar and hold a weight plate between your palms if you like.
Unrack the bar with a close grip and hold it over your chest.
Squeeze your hands inward as you lower the bar to your mid chest.
Press back up while still squeezing.
